corridor_domain.name: Pedestrian Corridor Containment
corridor_domain.rule: Canopy 2D footprint must be completely contained within Church Street pedestrian boundary polygon.

building_setback.name: Wall Collision and Setback
building_setback.rule: Canopy footprint must maintain at least 0.5 m clearance from all building walls.

pedestrian_clearance.name: Vertical Pedestrian Underside Clearance
pedestrian_clearance.rule: Underside height must be between 2.5 m and 5.5 m above ground.

canopy_area.name: Canopy Area Envelope
canopy_area.rule: Footprint area must be between 5.0 m² and 50.0 m².

structural_dimensions.name: Structural Aspect Ratio & Span Bounds
structural_dimensions.rule: Length in [2.0, 15.0], Width in [1.5, 6.0], Aspect Ratio in [1.0, 5.0].
